children: The US FDA said on Tuesday it has approved PolyPid's
treatment to reduce surgical-site infections in certain patients undergoing colorectal surgery.

The treatment, Bacfenssi, is approved for adults and children weighing at least 45 kg, or about 100 pounds, with incision lengths greater than 20 cm. It is applied once directly to the abdominal wall before the incision is closed, alongside standard care.

In a late-stage trial involving 798 patients, Bacfenssi reduced the rate of treatment failure within 30 days to 11%, from 18% with standard care alone. Treatment failure included surgical-site infection, death from any cause or another surgical procedure.
Surgical-site infections occurred in 4% of patients given Bacfenssi, compared to 10% of those who received standard care alone, the US Food and Drug Administration said.
